meta.note: Invoice status slug (migration 419). Native rows: open → pending_confirmation → partial/paid, or cancelled. ClubDesk mirror rows map their German status onto the same slugs.
ClubDesk login id of the recipient (Benutzer-Id).
Matched member (email, fallback cd_benutzer_id); NULL if unmatched.
Native team invoice (payable by the team's coach/captain/TR).
When the member self-reported payment (pending confirmation).
When payment was confirmed (sync or treasurer).
The dues batch that minted this native invoice (NULL for ad-hoc / ClubDesk rows).
Non-member billing recipient (sponsor/parent/company), if this native invoice is billed to one.
ClubDesk contact id of the recipient. Invoice identity is clubdesk_id (the ClubDesk Nummer).
Invoice positions (JSON). Sum equals the invoice amount.
